Title: General availability: Automatic key rotation of customer-managed keys for encrypting Azure disks

Body.Content:
Azure Disk Storage provides end to end encryption of data with your keys stored in Azure Key Vault. Now, you can choose to enable automatic rotation of your keys. When you generate a new version of a key in your Key Vault, the system will automatically update all the disks, snapshots, and images using the key to use the new version. You don’t have to manually update your resources to use the new version of the key.

Learn more.
